sources.entry: Belay - Keeps your Mac awake only while a local AI coding agent is working, and lets it sleep the moment the work stops. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/belay-awake-for-ai-agents/id6801207644)

summary.name: Belay
summary.one_liner: Belay is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake while local AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cline and Copilot CLI are working, then lets it sleep when they stop.
keywords: prevent sleep for long running jobs
use_cases: Keep a Mac awake during long Claude Code or Codex runs
Let the Mac sleep automatically once an AI agent finishes
Prevent sleep during long-running local coding agent tasks
Watch a custom folder for activity from other AI tools
summary.what_it_does: Belay keeps a Mac awake while a coding agent is working and releases the sleep block when the work stops. It has built-in detection for Claude Code, Codex, Cline and Copilot CLI, and one-click presets for Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Aider and Pi. Users can point it at a folder to support other tools. The page says detection runs locally, with no account, no telemetry, and that prompts or code are never sent anywhere.
notable: Detects agent activity locally with no account or telemetry
Built-in detection for Claude Code, Codex, Cline and Copilot CLI
Also listed on the Mac App Store
caveats: Works only with the listed agents or folders the user points it at
